newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish up sharply in brisk trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish up sharply in brisk trade.

text.p: June 12 - U.S. debt futures ended up sharply in brisk trade, buoyed by idea the Fed will stay on hold in July. Sept T-bond extended gains to hit 111-17/32 late, the highest level since late Feb. Despite heaps of dealer sales early, traders noted market sustained post-retail sales gains. All eyes now on May PPI, forecast up 0.1 pct overall and ex-food/energy.
